text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen arrived, and 
when I went to pick up Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! Shion and Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. Are you on your way to the 
racetrack too, Epi-san?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! More importantly—Verxina! I feel 
destiny with you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Your aura has really sharpened up lately! 
You've grown even more magnificent... and 
I'm thrilled to race you again!
choice_data_list: (Same as always...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. However... I 
believe you said the exact same thing to 
her as well, did you not?
choice_data_list: (She never changes...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Today is the race where she declared she 
would step down from the front lines— 
Which means today, of all days, I must 
achieve a complete victory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Do you really have the luxury to be 
flirting? ...Shion-san, I'm heading 
ahead."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...You can't just go in with the same
old 
attitude. People are watching closely, 
after all..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Shion! I get to race 
against you again!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Were you watching my run!?
Thanks to you, 
I'm still evolving even now!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I know that. A run like the Japan Cup 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It was just like...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Last summer, I was really inspired by 
how hard you worked. But—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Even if she's gone,
who's the one still 
standing on the turf today— I'm going to 
prove it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...That's right,
you have dreams you can't 
compromise on either! I can feel that 
fighting spirit you keep inside!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's pour all our feelings into this—
and 
have the best race ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Looong, loooong, looooong, loneliness!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... How troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Golshi! Gentil!! Morning!! Good to be 
working with you both again today!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "...Hmm? Hmm, hmm, hmm..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your yellowtail turned into a 
loofah too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "...SO LOOOOONG!! THIS HIIIIIIIILL!!"
choice_data_list: She's gone...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
She must be really fired up! I've gotta 
match Golshi's power!
choice_data_list: And there she goes...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it's a matter of strength...
please 
do not forget about me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Defeating you will make for the finest 
send-off. I can prove to everyone that I 
truly am the strongest, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina hinted at it earlier, too, but... 
Gentildonna has announced that today's 
race will mark her temporary step back 
from the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: So your mind's still made up, then?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I plan to take some time to 
rebuild and condition the foundation of
my 
body.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So that I may always show you my very 
finest back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san. Please, don't try to send a 
bouquet of flowers, alright?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Facing me with everything you have. That 
alone is the greatest gift of all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I wonder... how can I give F-chan 
the push she needs?
choice_data_list: What do you mean by... 'what kind ...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It got me thinking. Every girl running 
today is going to inspire someone from
now 
on—
choice_data_list: What do you mean, "how"...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"From the moment you start running and 
make it this far, it has already begun."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Among all of them...
what is the one thing 
only I can give to that girl I felt 
destiny with?
choice_data_list: ...Epi, what is it that you want t...
...Epi, what is it that you want t...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: ...What is it that you want to giv...
...What is it that you want to giv...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What a person thinks, how they walk their 
path, what they internalize as part of 
themselves... All you can convey is what 
exists within the light of the life 
they've lived.
choice_data_list: Because I can only give what I alr...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I ran true to myself, I was 
always happy."
choice_data_list: What do you want to show F?
What do you want to show F?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When I regained my confidence— power 
surged through my entire body!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No matter what destiny Eff finds herself 
in, I want her to always love the path
she 
chooses... and run true to herself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see. In that case—this really is 
the right choice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run and have a total blast! Head 
straight for the future with confidence!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And— I shall become all of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Déjà vu. Back at Make Debut,
she had said 
the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the weight behind them was
completely 
different. Right now, she— is speaking 
with resolve and responsibility.
choice_data_list: Epi, you've really... gotten so strong
Epi, you have truly... become so s...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you!
choice_data_list: Epi, you've really... gotten so st...
Epi, you've really... gotten so st...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because you were my 'destiny,' and my 
'voice.'

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always pushing me forward!
choice_data_list: Epi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you already know it! Something 
incredible is waiting wherever I go!"
choice_data_list: Epi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Today,
I'll take you to the greatest dream 
of all! Come, take my hand!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's go together!!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Epiphaneia!" "Epi-san!! We're 
rooting for you~~!" "I'm betting my
dreams 
on you today...!!"
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! I will definitely 
live up to all your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right,
keep your eyes on me! Follow 
this back of mine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall I unleash the ultimate 
light?!
